title: Steam Approval!
author: Enjoyooooor
selftext: Woke up this morning to a nice surprise…. My page got approved! For anyone that has launched is there any tips you could give me to prepare? I definitely will be editing my capsule. Would love some feedback on improvement!

comments.author: Bmpgames
comments.body: Thats not the hard part but congrats I guess. Just keep notes and keep checking things off like the professionals. Complete your game and levels etc and keep motivated.

replies.author: Enjoyooooor
replies.body: The question was more targeted towards marketing / or other things I can do to make launch successful. I am working double time to polish my build for the demo release on Steam.

replies.author: Bmpgames
replies.body: Well if ur like me you aim for perfection and never get to promotion lol so ya wish you well and will check ur game out

comments.author: Moist_Signal_5080
comments.body:
I suggest changing your title screen, the UI color and design looks like it doesn’t belong, and the creatures walking back and forth look off. They seem to just be walking across air, their coloring makes them pop from the background, like they are not part of it.  
The red blue and yellow bars look kinda cheap in game, I’m not sure great designer so I don’t know the answer. Those are just the immediate “AI” things that stand out to me. Hope the game goes well!

replies.author: Enjoyooooor
replies.body: Will definitely be changing the title menu atleast the icons . And thank you for the feedback!

replies.author: work_in_marketing
replies.body:
I'm curious if there's any decent tools for generating good UI design. I was quite disappointed with Claude Design. The colors and shading is nice but icons, backgrounds, and positioning is just so off. I guess it's trained more for websites than apps but I was still somewhat surprised.

I looked around at assets but I can't find the quality I want. Maybe I'm just struggling with visioning the result. At this moment I'm seriously considering hiring an artist but I'm sure it costs a small fortune considering this is a hobby project and good artists more so.

replies.author: Moist_Signal_5080
replies.body: I’d personally find games in my genre or style and use those for inspiration. Either as a way to help describe what you want to Claude, or just straight give Claude a screen shot of it. Of course tell it to make it unique and not a 1 to 1

replies.author: AustinMHowe
replies.body: Use ChatGPT for UI mockups and then have Claude or others implement.
